Experience with network monitoring / NDR, flow analysis, and lateral-movement detection. Adversarial mindset — able to assess architectural weaknesses from an attacker's view and deliver risk-graded (CRITICAL–LOW) mitigation and detection strategies. AI data center / GPU cluster networking experience; familiarity with InfiniBand/RoCE/UFM. eBPF-based observability (Tetragon / Cilium). Financial-grade / high-compliance industry security background. CISSP / CCNP Security or equivalent certification. Working proficiency in both Chinese and English.
